title: fix(i18n): the record timeline's events chip reads 事件 / Events, and the Chinese stream says 动态
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oLLK7uoxp33riiBJL

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTRdLmK9YYgMSCJ7NH2PuUY)_
Fixes #36148

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 7074372050

## 维护者速读

- 记录页「动态」里的筛选从「全部 · 活动 · 讨论 · 变更」改为「全部 · 事件 · 讨论 · 变更」,英文 Events;中文的空状态改为「暂无动态」,旧标题、无权限、加载失败和筛选读屏标签都改说「动态」。
- 按你 04:45 选的 A(「A 改叫「事件」」)执行;每个筛选装什么不变,「变更」仍只放带前后值的字段变更(#30074 裁定 C)。
- 出错时最坏是某个语言的筛选或空状态字眼不对,不影响数据;只改语言包的值和一处英文兜底,可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `detail.streamActivity` (the stream's events chip): zh-Hans and zh-Hant 「事件」, en `Events`, and each other pack's own word for events: de `Ereignisse`, es `Eventos`, fr `Événements`, ja `イベント`, ko `이벤트`, pt-BR `Eventos`, ru `События`, ar `الأحداث`. The row reads 「全部 · 事件 · 讨论 · 变更」. What the chip holds is unchanged (ruling 6649643659 on #30074, option C).
- zh-Hans and zh-Hant only, the rest of the stream takes the tab's word: `detail.noActivity` 「暂无动态」 / 「暫無動態」 (the panel's one empty state, drawn under every chip), `detail.activity` 「动态」 / 「動態」 (now equal to `detail.timeline`, as in the other nine packs), `detail.activityAccessDenied`, `detail.activityLoadFailed` and `detail.filterActivity` say 动态. The other packs keep those four values.
- `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`: the events chip's in-code English fallback follows the pack (`'Events'`); comments naming the chip row updated there and in `recordTimelineStream.ts`.
- Values only: no key added, renamed or removed. zh-Hant matches what `gen:zh-hant` writes (the generator left the pack unchanged after the edit).

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts` — the six `detail` values.
2. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` — `streamActivity: 'Events'`.
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/timelineFilterWording-36148.test.ts` — the new pins.

Two-minute verification: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/timelineFilterWording-36148.test.ts` from the repo root; expect 16 passed.

## Tests

- New `timelineFilterWording-36148.test.ts` (i18n): in zh-Hans and zh-Hant no string the stream draws (title, chips, empty, access-denied, load-failed, filter label) says 活动 / 活動, and the chip, empty state and title read 事件 / 暂无动态 / 动态; en names the chip Events; in every pack the events chip differs from the tab word, the stream title and the field-history chip.
- Old pins updated to the ruled words: `ActivityTimeline.i18n.test.tsx` (zh empty state), `ActivityTimeline.remainingLiterals.i18n.test.tsx` (zh card title, whole zh card text, chip group label), `detail-landmark-aria-i18n-4645.test.tsx` (zh landmark name).
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): zh-Hans `streamActivity` set back to 「活动」 on disk after the commit: 2 failed / 14 passed ("no string the stream draws says 活动", "the chip reads 事件 …"); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, 16 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- Done-when, measured live: hotcrm (18.6.0 server, `pnpm dev` on a fresh database) with this branch's Console source (Vite, `DEV_PROXY_TARGET` to the hotcrm server), a zh-CN browser, admin user, a seeded lead. The record tab row reads 「线索 · 客户 · 活动 · 活动参与者 · 任务 · 营销活动成员 2 · 动态 2」 and the stream heads 「动态 (2)」. Every 活动 on the page is one of hotcrm's own labels (the `crm_event` tab and nav entry, 活动参与者, 营销活动成员, 销售活动). On this page the 动态 tab is a slotted page's `record:chatter`, which since #36221 lists the system history alone, so no chip row draws there; the chips and empty state are pinned by the tests above rather than by this page.
- Out of the claim's declared surface (locale packs): `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` (the en fallback, named by the ruling), `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/recordTimelineStream.ts` (comments only) and three plugin-detail pin tests. None is a seat-1 hot file.
- Out of the claim's declared surface, added at `dd26af31`: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, `KNOWN_LABEL_DICT` `Activity` 「活动」/「活動」 → 「动态」/「動態」, with `@object-ui/components` in the changeset. Why: it is the page-tab strip's own copy of the label, read ahead of the pack, so without it an authored `Activity` tab kept 活动 and `page-tabs-builtin-label-i18n-4645.test.tsx` went red on `12a825da` (Test UI 4/16). Ruling 7074372050 item 3 sets an authored `Activity` tab to 动态, the same word as `detail.timeline`. Claim amended on #36148 for this file and `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`.
- Residual (stated, not a defect): in zh an `Activity` tab and the `Activity stream` tab both read 动态. Both draw on one strip only when a page author writes both labels. Measured: the synthesized record page writes only `Activity stream` (`buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:1094`); no authored `Activity` page tab in `examples/**` or hotcrm (the `'Activity'` hits are an object label and a nav group). The equality is the ruling's choice (item 3).
- Not changed, measured: `useDetailTranslation.ts` has no `detail.streamActivity` default, so there is no second English fallback for the chip.
